# Netcontrol source boundary fixture

`61364846/` contains the complete original package subtree and root GPL-2.0 LICENSE from
https://github.com/rule2c/luci-app-netcontrol/commit/61364846e1188d87801f778749efc4f2a4deac43.
The manifest records original Git blobs, SHA-256 and modes. Tests place these bytes in a local
Git donor, advance its default branch, and exercise real pinned source transfer. No runtime
network-control script is executed by these tests.
